## Original Published Paper

[IEEE Xplore](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/469759){class="flux-button _3"}
[ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/220018231_The_41_View_Model_of_Architecture){class="flux-button _3"}

## The Views

View | Brief Description
-|-
Logical     | Object model of the design
Process     | Concurrency and synchronization aspects
Development | Static organization of software
Physical    | Mapping of software on hardware
Scenarios   | Use cases

## Logical View

### Answers Question
What should the system provide to its users?

### This View Contains

- Structural logic
- High level view of classes and relationships

### Avoid

- Specialization of classes
- Core affinity
- Task

## Process View

State transition diagrams

## Glossary

Term | Definition
-|-
Task    | A thread of control, scheduled individually
Process | Grouping of tasks that form an executable unit
